scenario: LLOG.11.9 — a logical emit in an after body is refused with DS_VALIDATE_LOGICAL_EMIT_SELF_ENDING. Drives the validator's deferred-body check: the schema is declared logical and the emit carries the flag, so the two lifecycle checks of LFAC.1.3.1 / LLOG.11.1 both pass and the refusal is this clause's, not theirs.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Delayed scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule delayed:
    Trig
->
    after 5_s:
        emit Delayed logical dummy: 0
